title: CreeperControl
description: Control creeper explosions and breed creepers when explosions are disabled. Configurable for players, mobs, and blocks. Compatible with Paper 1.21.7 and Spigot/Bukkit.
body:
💥 CreeperControl 1.0.0 – Take Charge of Your Creepers! 💥

Tired of Creepers destroying your hard work? 😱
CreeperControl lets YOU control the chaos! Smarter Creepers, safer worlds, and full customization – all at your fingertips.

🚀 Features You’ll Love:

🧠 Smart Creeper AI: Creepers act clever, but the fun never stops!

🌍 World-Specific Settings: Survival, Creative, PvP – each world gets its own rules.

⚡ Easy Admin Commands: Adjust explosions, spawns, and protected zones instantly.

💨 Optimized Performance: Minimal lag, even on huge worlds!

✅ Fully Compatible: Minecraft 1.21.x+ ready.

🔥 Why Install CreeperControl?

Protect your builds 🏰

Control Creeper chaos without ruining gameplay 💣

Perfect for servers, map makers, and survival enthusiasts 🎮

Don’t just survive – THRIVE! Take control of Creepers today and turn every world into YOUR world. 🌟

👉 Download now and master Creepers like a pro!
